title: Force ECall Redial Mode
description: Mirrors EcallStateMachine::ModemRedial's config test-hook (SUCCESS/CALLORIG/CALLDROP). Sticky override, same convention as force_ecall_timer_failure -- applies to every eCall started on every phoneId, not just the next one, until a later call with config=SUCCESS clears it. config=SUCCESS dials normally (the default). config=CALLORIG/CALLDROP fails the first dial attempt and enters the Redialing loop; succeedAtAttempt (1-based, counting from the first redial retry) makes that specific attempt connect instead of failing again, leaving all later attempts unfired -- omit/null to let every configured attempt fail through to MAX_REDIAL_ATTEMPTED. Not bounds-checked against the active config's table length (10 for CALLORIG, 2 for CALLDROP); a value beyond it simply never matches.
